label: Started Ph.D. at University of Heidelberg
description: Began his scientific career as a young Ph.D. student at the Institute for Botany.

sources.quote: In the 1970th, a new era began for the young Ph.D. student Wilhelm Barthlott at the Institute for Botany of the University of Heidelberg.

label: Started using scanning electron microscopy
description: Received one of the first scanning electron microscopes in German botany to study micro- and nanostructures.

sources.quote: He received one of the first scanning electron microscopes in German botany and started to intensively study the fascinating world of micro- and nanostructures of leaves, flowers, seeds or pollen grains.

label: Formulated self-cleaning hypothesis
description: Hypothesized that self-cleaning might be one of the most important functions of rough water-repellent leaf surfaces.

sources.quote: Wilhelm Barthlott formulated the hypothesis very early that "self-cleaning" might be one of the most important functions of rough water-repellent leaf surfaces [12]

label: Appointed professor at University of Bonn
description: Resumed research on self-cleaning surfaces after appointment as professor for botany.

sources.quote: Some years later, now appointed as professor for botany at the University of Bonn, Wilhelm Barthlott resumed this research.

label: Proved self-cleaning properties
description: Proved the astonishing self-cleaning properties of rough water-repellent surfaces by the end of the 1980s.

sources.quote: we were able to prove the astonishing self-cleaning properties of rough water-repellent surfaces by the end of the 1980s

label: Published internal report at University of Bonn
description: Released an internal report on self-cleaning ability of plant surfaces.

sources.quote: Apart from an internal report of the University of Bonn [39] several attempts to publish the results failed.

label: Published paper in Planta
description: Paper appeared in Planta five years after the first submission with help from Andreas Sievers.

sources.quote: Finally, with the help of the former editor Andreas Sievers, the paper appeared in "Planta" five years after the first submission [40]

label: Published survey in Annals of Botany
description: Followed by a survey about the characterisation and distribution of self-cleaning surfaces among plants.

sources.quote: followed by a survey about the characterisation and distribution of self-cleaning surfaces among plants [41].
